entries.title: Leviticus 19:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 19:2
segments: "Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say to them: 'You shall be holy, for I the LORD your God [am] holy.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:3
segments: 'Every one of you shall revere his mother and his father, and keep My Sabbaths: I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:4
segments: 'Do not turn to idols, nor make for yourselves molded gods: I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:5
segments: 'And if you offer a sacrifice of a peace offering to the LORD, you shall offer it of your own free will.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:6
segments: 'It shall be eaten the same day you offer [it], and on the next day. And if any remains until the third day, it shall be burned in the fire.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:7
segments: 'And if it is eaten at all on the third day, it [is] an abomination. It shall not be accepted.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:8
segments: 'Therefore [everyone] who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the hallowed [offering] of the LORD; and that person shall be cut off from his people.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:9
segments: 'When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, nor shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:10
segments: 'And you shall not glean your vineyard, nor shall you gather [every] grape of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and the stranger: I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:11
segments: ¶'You shall not steal, nor deal falsely, nor lie to one another.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:12
segments: 'And you shall not swear by My name falsely, nor shall you profane the name of your God: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:13
segments: 'You shall not cheat your neighbor, nor rob [him]. The wages of him who is hired shall not remain with you all night until morning.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:14
segments: 'You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind, but shall fear your God: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:15
segments: 'You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty. In righteousness you shall judge your neighbor.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:16
segments: 'You shall not go about [as] a talebearer among your people; nor shall you take a stand against the life of your neighbor: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:17
segments: 'You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:18
segments: 'You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:19
segments: ¶'You shall keep My statutes. You shall not let your livestock breed with another kind. You shall not sow your field with mixed seed. Nor shall a garment of mixed linen and wool come upon you.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:20
segments: 'Whoever lies carnally with a woman who [is] betrothed to a man as a concubine, and who has not at all been redeemed nor given her freedom, for this there shall be scourging; [ but] they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:21
segments: 'And he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, a ram as a trespass offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:22
segments: 'The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed. And the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:23
segments: 'When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as uncircumcised. Three years it shall be as uncircumcised to you. [It] shall not be eaten.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:24
segments: 'But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, a praise to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:25
segments: 'And in the fifth year you may eat its fruit, that it may yield to you its increase: I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:26
segments: 'You shall not eat [anything] with the blood, nor shall you practice divination or soothsaying.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:27
segments: 'You shall not shave around the sides of your head, nor shall you disfigure the edges of your beard.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:28
segments: 'You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:29
segments: 'Do not prostitute your daughter, to cause her to be a harlot, lest the land fall into harlotry, and the land become full of wickedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:30
segments: ¶'You shall keep My Sabbaths and reverence My sanctuary: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:31
segments: 'Give no regard to mediums and familiar spirits; do not seek after them, to be defiled by them: I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:32
segments: 'You shall rise before the gray headed and honor the presence of an old man, and fear your God: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:33
segments: 'And if a stranger dwells with you in your land, you shall not mistreat him.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:34
segments: 'The stranger who dwells among you shall be to you as one born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:35
segments: 'You shall do no injustice in judgment, in measurement of length, weight, or volume.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:36
segments: 'You shall have honest scales, honest weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin: I [am] the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Leviticus 19:37
segments: 'Therefore you shall observe all My statutes and all My judgments, and perform them: I [am] the LORD.'"
